<!-- Thanks for contributing! The checks verify the format; this is for what they can't. -->

**What kind of change?** (keep one) New question · Reword / fix a question · New certification · Docs · Other

**Why** (for a reword or fix: what was wrong, e.g. "Basic SKU retired", "two answers were both right"):

- [ ] The scenario is my own, written from Microsoft Learn (not copied from an exam, braindump, course or other site)
- [ ] Every explanation follows from the Learn page(s) in `documentation`
